criterion: which entity type the entity named at the end of the text ("The entity type of X") belongs to

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A group of people structured and managed to meet a need or pursue collective goals.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: A particular place or position.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: An occurrence or happening, especially one of significance.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: An item or service created or manufactured for sale.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: A prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: A system of communication used by a particular country or community.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: A system of money in general use in a particular country.

categories.name: Species
categories.definition: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.

categories.name: Chemical
categories.definition: A compound or substance that has been purified or prepared, especially artificially.

categories.name: Title
categories.definition: The name of a book, composition, or other artistic work.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A thing used for transporting people or goods, especially on land, such as a car, truck, or cart.

categories.name: Concept
categories.definition: An abstract idea or a general notion.

categories.name: Artifact
categories.definition: An object made by a human being, typically one of cultural or historical interest.

categories.name: Natural Phenomenon
categories.definition: A natural event or fact that is observable.

categories.name: Food
categories.definition: Any nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink or that plants absorb in order to maintain life and growth.

categories.name: Disease
categories.definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant, especially one that produces specific symptoms or that affects a specific location and is not simply a direct result of physical injury.

categories.name: Material
categories.definition: The matter from which a thing is or can be made.

categories.name: Instrument
categories.definition: A tool or implement, especially one for delicate or scientific work.

categories.name: Structure
categories.definition: A building or other object constructed from several parts.

categories.name: Institution
categories.definition: An organization founded for a religious, educational, professional, or social purpose.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A book, journal, or other work that is published.

categories.name: Mythology
categories.definition: A collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: An activity involving physical exertion and skill in which an individual or team competes against another or others for entertainment.

categories.name: Art
categories.definition: The expression or application of human creative skill and imagination, typically in a visual form such as painting or sculpture, producing works to be appreciated primarily for their beauty or emotional power.

categories.name: Political Entity
categories.definition: An entity that is involved in the political process, such as a government or political party.

categories.name: Historical Period
categories.definition: A distinct period of time in history.

categories.name: Measurement
categories.definition: The size, length, or amount of something, as established by measuring.

categories.name: Media
categories.definition: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the internet) regarded collectively.
